_meta.description: Pneumatic audit journal. Hooked into the built-in logs-otel@template, which already lists logs-otel@custom in composed_of, so Elasticsearch keeps owning the OTel document shape and only these settings are ours. Settings only, no mappings: a component template that redefines the passthrough object attributes or resource.attributes REPLACES the properties of the built-in components instead of merging with them, and the field aliases of semconv-resource-to-ecs@mappings then point at fields that no longer exist (checked on 9.5.3: 'an alias must refer to an existing field in the mappings'). The dynamic mapping already gives keyword to every attribute of the event schema, which is what the schema needs.
